title: KnowledgeReceipt
description: Proof that an agent consulted the knowledge for a task (ADR-0039). Returned by knowledge_consult and appended to the receipt log (ADR-0040). Holds ids, hashes, codes and times only: never the task text, a card title or any other content. `hash` is the JCS hash of the receipt without `hash`.

queryHash.description: JCS hash of the task text; the text itself is never stored.

target.description: The disclosure class of the agent connection (ADR-0037).

packageId.description: Id of the context package the consult returned.

result.description: cards: the package delivered cards (cardIds lists exactly them); nothing_found: no card matched; confirmation_required: a cloud_model connection without a confirmed transfer (ADR-0031). All three prove a consult.

allOf.description: Only a consult that delivered cards names cards.
A consult waiting for a cloud confirmation names its transfer and comes from a cloud_model connection.

consultRequest.title: KnowledgeConsultRequest
consultRequest.description: Input of knowledge_consult: a context package request (ADR-0016) plus the task. Target and agent come from the connection. The task text is hashed into the receipt and never stored.

task.description: What the agent is about to do, as the question for the context package.

transferId.description: For a cloud_model connection: the transfer the human confirmed after a first consult returned confirmation_required (ADR-0031).

consultResult.title: KnowledgeConsultResult
consultResult.description: Output of knowledge_consult: the gate-cleared context package and the receipt for it.
